cards.title: Tidepool Clock Shell Return
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper backpack ending card for closing a pretend tidepool lab tale when one small object comes back changed: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place the card beside a blank backpack pocket shape and choose one invented tidepool object together: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: End your tidepool lab tale by bringing one make-believe object back to where it belongs: ____________________.
cards.endingChoicePrompt: Ending choice: decide whether the shell clock is returned quietly, proudly, or with a tiny new tick: ____________________.
cards.feelingPrompt: Feeling prompt: show how the timekeeper feels after the tidepool object is safely back: ____________________.
cards.objectReturnPrompt: Object return: name the shell, bead, bubble note, or kelp tag that comes back at the end: ____________________.
cards.echoPrompt: Echo prompt: repeat one early tidepool detail in a fresh way near the final sentence: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: write the last sentence that leaves the lab calm and clear: ____________________.
cards.reviseEndingPrompt: Revise ending: add one tide, clock, shell, or ripple detail so the ending feels earned: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: draw the returned object first, then write only its ending word: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-along line: fold this card into a pretend backpack pocket and add one more calm ending clue: ____________________.

cards.title: Revision River Ferry Last Dock
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper backpack ending card for turning a fuzzy ferry draft into a clearer fictional final moment: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: offer one plain ferry sentence and one blank backpack pocket shape for a stronger ending: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Rewrite the ferry ending so the final dock shows what changed in the make-believe draft: ____________________.
cards.endingChoicePrompt: Ending choice: choose the ferry landing, cargo swap, or dock bell that closes the tale best: ____________________.
cards.feelingPrompt: Feeling prompt: show what the ferry helper understands after the revised crossing: ____________________.
cards.objectReturnPrompt: Object return: bring back one paper oar tag, lantern slip, or basket clue from earlier in the tale: ____________________.
cards.echoPrompt: Echo prompt: echo one word from the first ferry sentence, but make it sharper now: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: write the closing ferry sentence with one concrete detail: ____________________.
cards.reviseEndingPrompt: Revise ending: replace one vague ending word with a clearer river, dock, basket, or bell word: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: write old ending arrow new ending before making the full change: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-along line: keep this card in the pretend backpack pocket and revise one more final sentence: ____________________.

cards.title: Clue Label Tower Echo Tag
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper backpack ending card for closing a fictional label mystery by answering or echoing one useful question: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out two pretend exhibit labels and invite the writer to keep every clue made up: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: End the tower museum tale by letting the final label echo the question from earlier: ____________________.
cards.endingChoicePrompt: Ending choice: decide whether the label gives an answer, a tiny hint, or a new gentle question: ____________________.
cards.feelingPrompt: Feeling prompt: show how the clue finder feels when the final tag makes sense: ____________________.
cards.objectReturnPrompt: Object return: bring back one exhibit tag, ribbon card, or folded label from the opening: ____________________.
cards.echoPrompt: Echo prompt: repeat the tale's first question with one changed word at the end: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: write the museum ending sentence that lets the label feel complete: ____________________.
cards.reviseEndingPrompt: Revise ending: move one clue closer to the final label so the question echo is clear: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: write only the echoed question and circle the changed word: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-along line: tuck this card into a pretend backpack pocket and invent one more final label: ____________________.

cards.title: Compass Craft Final Turn
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper backpack ending card for closing a fictional compass craft tale with one thoughtful choice: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place a paper compass beside the card and name every direction as invented story play: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: End the compass craft tale by choosing one final turn and showing why it fits: ____________________.
cards.endingChoicePrompt: Ending choice: choose north-thread, east-bead, south-fold, or west-paper as the final turn: ____________________.
cards.feelingPrompt: Feeling prompt: show what the crafter feels after choosing the final direction: ____________________.
cards.objectReturnPrompt: Object return: bring back one paper needle, bead string, fold card, or compass tag at the end: ____________________.
cards.echoPrompt: Echo prompt: echo one early direction word so the ending connects to the beginning: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: write the last compass sentence with the choice and its clear reason: ____________________.
cards.reviseEndingPrompt: Revise ending: add one small clue that makes the final turn feel planned, not random: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: mark one compass point silently, then write its ending reason: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-along line: slide this card into a pretend backpack pocket and add a new choice ending: ____________________.

cards.title: Binding Day Boardwalk Promise Knot
cards.useCase: Adult-led paper backpack ending card for finishing a fictional boardwalk booklet with one clear promise line: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: fold a blank paper booklet and ask for only invented boardwalk, page, and button details: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: End the binding day tale by writing the promise that ties the final page together: ____________________.
cards.endingChoicePrompt: Ending choice: choose whether the promise is kept with a button, thread loop, page clasp, or folded sign: ____________________.
cards.feelingPrompt: Feeling prompt: show how the binder feels when the loose pages finally fit: ____________________.
cards.objectReturnPrompt: Object return: bring back one button tag, thread loop, page corner, or boardwalk token from earlier: ____________________.
cards.echoPrompt: Echo prompt: echo the first page's worry with a calmer final version: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: write the promise line that closes the booklet and leaves one bright image: ____________________.
cards.reviseEndingPrompt: Revise ending: add one earlier object to the final promise so the ending feels connected: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: write only the promise and the object that helps keep it: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-along line: keep this card with the pretend backpack pocket and write another promise ending: ____________________.
